# proxmox_qemu_agent (Data Source)

Reads guest agent facts of a running QEMU VM: supported commands, OS info, host name, timezone, filesystems and network interfaces. Requires the guest agent inside the VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_agent" "facts" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `vmid` (Number) QEMU VM ID.

### Read-Only

- `commands` (List of String) Commands the agent supports.
- `filesystems` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filesystems))
- `host_name` (String)
- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
- `osinfo` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--osinfo))
- `timezone` (String)
- `timezone_offset` (Number)
